cases.proves_bugs: BUG-743 (part: the explicit Blank keyword means not known even after a typed level, and Enter with nothing typed in this drawing means not known; the other-drawing half is NOT driven, Codex look)
cases.title: CDTG cover level: Blank gives no level even after a typed 45.2, Enter with nothing typed gives no level, Enter after 45.2 in the same drawing gives PCL 45.200
cases.plan_item: Bug-proof plan wave 1 (BUG_PROOF_PLAN_31OCT.md), group T: CDTG trench grate Enter to skip
cases.expected: Four trench grates by CDTG, each 2 m, width 300, Standard, class C, outlet skipped. Grate A: Enter at the cover level prompt: its callout has no PCL line. Grate B: 45.2 typed: its callout ends 'PCL 45.200 m AHD'. Grate C: Blank typed: its callout has no PCL line. Grate D: Enter: its callout ends 'PCL 45.200 m AHD' (the level typed in this drawing). The cover prompt reads 'Cover Level (m AHD) or [Blank] <enter to skip>'. Four TRENCH GRATE blocks are added, nothing is cancelled, no CE window is left open and the drawing file is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The cover level remembered between two live CDTG runs, the Blank keyword at AutoCAD's own number prompt and the callout written into the drawing only meet in a real AutoCAD session.
not_automated: BUG-743's main case, Enter in ANOTHER drawing (job B) after a level typed in job A, needs a second drawing open in the same AutoCAD session; the driver cannot open one. Codex look: in one AutoCAD, CDTG in drawing A with 45.2, open a copy saved under another name, CDTG there, press Enter: the callout must have no PCL line.
The look of the callout (position, two lines, the dash) and the record's stored cover level (ProjectData CoverLevel blank versus 45.200) are not read; only the callout text is.
